what: T1P result: Tier 1 precision, trained from scratch on the clean tier_1 references
when: launched 2026-11-03 01:03 UTC, all seven cells complete by ~06:30 UTC
arm: START + orientation std 0.3 + object_position std 0.08, seed 42, 349,999,104 steps, world_count 1, scene.support per clip (all seven resolved true)
clips: e02 e09 e11 e13 e17 e21 e29 -- the seven Tier 1 clips sitting 3.85-5.15 cm outside the 3 cm MP-SR gate
cost_note: finished cells billed $2.64-$2.92 each; plus ~$1.50 lost to the mount-bug wave and a hung build (b21). Boxes ran ~4 h, not the 5.4 h budgeted.

refused_why.e09: no checkpoint beat the bar; its orientation error never fell below 45 deg at any of the seven, and e09 was already identified as failing SP-SR on the 0.5 rad orientation criterion rather than on position. A position-tightening recipe could not reach it.

board_effect.place_unchanged: We were tied with Team OPS at 43; 39 breaks that tie and leaves us alone in 12th with Team OPS 13th. maniphys.ai at 30 is still ahead, so 11th needs nine more rank points, which Tier 1 can no longer supply cheaply.

findings.selection_is_not_worthless_after_all: On Tier 2 the registered z-drop rule was worth +0.0010 AUC over the final checkpoint and we recorded that as settled. Here it is worth +0.0565 on the entry mean, because the per-clip curves are violent: e02 peaks at 300M and collapses to 0.387/65 cm by 350M, while e13 and e21 climb to their best at 350M. Six different clips, two different optimal budgets.
findings.the_truth_free_rule_matched_the_oracle: z-drop picked the same checkpoint as the kit-best choice on 6 of 6 adoptions, reading only the input reference (ground_truth_read: false). On e02 it identified the single drop-free checkpoint out of seven.
findings.nothing_before_250M_was_ever_useful: Across all seven clips every checkpoint at 50M-200M was far below its bar, often catastrophically (e11 at 200M scored 0.036 AUC). The recipe's entire value is in the last 30% of training.
findings.six_of_seven_checkpoints_drop_the_object: On e02, six of seven drop it, at frames 192-807; only 300M holds all 980 frames. The policy passes through competence rather than converging to it, which is direct support for the grasp-instability diagnosis.
findings.the_step_function_bites: e29 gained +0.223 AUC and e21 +0.531, but both land inside rungs already crossed, so they add no rank points. Four MP-SR flips give 0.6333 where the next rank needs three more clips.

tier1_is_now_exhausted: After T1P the next Tier 1 rungs cost -55.5 cm of summed MPPE, +1.04 of summed AUC, or three more MP-SR clips -- 10 to 30 times what this arm delivered. The cheap Tier 1 gains are harvested.
